faq.q: Can I read fuel level remotely on a Jeep Cherokee?
faq.a: Yes. A DIMO device reports fuel level as the Fuel Percentage signal (powertrainFuelSystemRelativeLevel) in %. You can query it through the Telemetry API, using a Vehicle JWT obtained from the Token Exchange API.

faq.q: How do I track a Jeep Cherokee with no connected services?
faq.a: Use a DIMO device. The Jeep Cherokee record lists the DIMO LTE R1 as its connection, so no OEM connected services are needed. Once the vehicle is shared with your Developer License, you can read its signals through the Telemetry API.

faq.q: How do I detect idling on a Jeep Cherokee?
faq.a: Query the Telemetry API segments resource with the idling detection mechanism, which requires a DIMO device. Idling segments are contiguous periods where engine RPM stays in the idle range, and you can tune the idle limit with maxIdleRpm (default 1000).

faq.q: How do I verify Jeep Cherokee mileage?
faq.a: A DIMO device reports the Odometer signal (powertrainTransmissionTravelledDistance) in km. To get verifiable proof, call the Attestation API odometer-statement endpoint with a Vehicle JWT, then retrieve the attestation through the Telemetry API.

intro: DIMO gives developers API access to vehicle-state data: diagnostics, fault codes, battery and fuel health, odometer, and maintenance signals. For the Jeep Cherokee, coverage comes through a DIMO device, the DIMO LTE R1, on model years 2015 and newer. This coverage has been tested rather than assumed. The record lists no OEM or other connection types for this vehicle. DIMO adds vehicle-state depth on top of GPS tracking; it doesn't replace it.
